purpose: Teach: 環境庁/窒素/憲章/圧勝/疑念/塩素/至福/皇族

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、環境庁時代の規制研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on environmental regulations from your time at the Environment Ministry, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Measured pace. Leaning into genuine curiosity about his work. Open posture of a teacher who respects her student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、窒素酸化物の削減策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on strategies for reducing nitrogen oxide emissions.
lines.style: Careful, precise delivery. Slight hesitation as if choosing words accurately. Quiet confidence in the technical material. Respectful toward the teacher's attention.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、国連憲章の改正案を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored the UN Charter amendments in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Slight pause between clauses. Curious without pressure. The measured voice of someone drawing out what her student has learned.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、選挙での圧勝事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined electoral landslides as case studies.
lines.style: Direct, steady delivery. Slight dip in energy at the end—the earnestness of a student answering clearly but without embellishment. Respectful attention.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治家への疑念を市民が抱く構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The structural reasons why citizens develop distrust of politicians—you covered that angle, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged, animated slightly. Genuine interest in the complexity of the topic. Leaning forward with the curiosity of a teacher who sees real thinking. Warm without being effusive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、プールの塩素濃度管理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I studied chlorine concentration management protocols for public pools.
lines.style: Brief, factual delivery. Slight flatness in tone—student answers straightforwardly but without apparent connection to the question. Quiet, almost resigned politeness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、登山家の至福体験を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The transcendent experiences mountaineers report—you examined that phenomenon, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, almost contemplative tone. Unhurried pacing. Gentle curiosity. The voice of a teacher who thinks carefully about what her questions mean.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、英王室皇族の役割を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the constitutional role of the British Royal Family.
lines.style: Quiet, precise closing. Steady eye contact level. The earnestness held even as the answer seems unmoored from the question. Respectful finish.
